title: Why your f*cking phone dies at 20% (Vex f-word explainer: Li-ion chemistry, Derek cameo; Scribe handwriting picker)

voice.name: Dolly (generic Fish library voice) at the Nov 10 regular pace

beats.say: Why your fucking phone fucking dies at twenty fucking percent.
Your fucking battery is lithium ions doing fucking laps. Charging shoves them to one fucking side. Scrolling lets them run back.
And that fucking percentage? It's a fucking guess. Your phone reads the voltage and estimates.
But old batteries choke. Open a big fucking app, the voltage dips under the cutoff, and it shuts the fuck off. With twenty fucking percent left.
And my fucking chem homework? It's literally batteries. Cute.
So I send it to Scribe. It writes the whole fucking thing in my handwriting. Cell diagram and all.
Teacher can't read it? Swap the fucking handwriting.
Oh, and every full charge wears it down. Five hundred fucking cycles? About eighty percent left.
Cold makes it worse. The ions get slow as fuck.
And heat over ninety-five degrees? Cooks it for fucking good.
Now go charge your fucking phone.
